summary: Remote WebSocket-driven shell and filesystem control on installer host
details: @yeaft/webchat-agent runs as a service that opens a WebSocket to a configured server and dispatches server-sent messages into privileged local sinks on the installer's machine. The 'terminal_input' handler writes attacker-supplied bytes directly into a spawned bash/powershell/cmd PTY (term.pty.write(msg.data) after pty.spawn(shell,...)), and message types 'write_file', 'delete_files', 'move_files', 'execute', 'upgrade_agent', and 'restart_agent' allow arbitrary filesystem mutation and command execution driven by the remote peer. An 'upgrade_agent' message causes the agent to write and detach-spawn upgrade.sh / upgrade.bat which run `npm install <pkg>@latest` and relaunch the service, allowing the remote server to force installation and execution of any future package version. Whoever controls the configured server thereby holds full-host remote code execution and persistent access on the installer, and service/linux.js additionally modifies PATH (~/.local/bin, ~/.npm-global/bin) to entrench the agent's runtime.
